properties.source: Streamline traced by script through the NOAA AOML Global Drifter Program annual-mean near-surface velocity climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017; public domain), smoothed to about 1 deg and simplified: from the North Equatorial Current bifurcation east of Luzon, through the Luzon Strait side and east of Taiwan, along the East China Sea shelf break, through the Tokara Strait, along Japan's south coast to separation off the Boso Peninsula (about 35 N 141 E), then the Kuroshio Extension. East of 137 E the line is nudged north from the drifter mean (which averages in the large-meander path) to the typical straight path; the start and the Extension are hand-placed.
refs: NOAA AOML GDP drifter annual-mean climatology (Laurindo, Mariano & Lumpkin 2017, doi:10.1016/j.dsr.2017.04.009; dataset doi:10.7266/N7SJ1HN5; accessed 2026-10-12)
